actions.targets: One separately named JSON migration output
actions.inspect: Source JSON, registered kind, source version, target version, and output conflict
actions.plan: Exact migrated document with unknown fields preserved
actions.apply: Atomically create a separate non-conflicting output file
actions.verify: Re-read bytes, compare the planned payload, and record SHA-256
actions.record: Command JSON result; the verified output is the migration artifact
actions.backup_rollback: Source is never modified; discard the separate output if it is not adopted
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling never replaces the source; rerun after inspecting the output path
actions.idempotency: An existing byte-identical output is reported unchanged; a different output is refused

actions.targets: One new redacted diagnostic ZIP at the exact reviewed output path
actions.inspect: Controlled checks, versions, public policy hashes, bounded logs, redaction counts, and output conflict
actions.plan: Manifest, file hashes, predicted ZIP hash, failure classes, and redaction preview
actions.apply: Atomically create a new ZIP containing diagnostics, redaction report, and manifest
actions.verify: Reopen ZIP, enforce exact members, verify every manifest hash, and rerun sensitive-pattern checks
actions.record: The verified ZIP plus command JSON result; publication remains unauthorized
actions.backup_rollback: No source is changed; delete the new ZIP if the user rejects it after local review
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and an existing output is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: Preview is repeatable; export refuses every existing destination instead of replacing it
